title: Large edge count forces a perfect matching
statement:
Let $G$ be a finite simple graph on $n$ vertices with $m$ edges and minimum degree $\delta$. Suppose that $n$ is even, that $2\delta < n$, and that
\[ m > \binom{\delta}{2} + \binom{n - 2\delta - 1}{2} + \delta\,(n - \delta). \]
Then $G$ has a perfect matching.
